content: {"episode_id":"ep-05007","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for mobile cardiac telemetry, which the payer letter states was denied because precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) in the setting of an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9). Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic causes. Authorization status is missing, and this appeal is submitted 45 days from service, within the 135 days remaining to the filing deadline."}
